description:
Search notes and daily logs and summarise thread activity; returns pointers and metadata, never document bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text S] [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — find notes by thread, type, date range or text
  logs [--thread T] [--text S] [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — find daily logs by thread, date range or text
  activity [--thread T] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a window
  overview THREAD [--limit N] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread

Flags:
  notes: --thread thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink; --type note type such as Meeting, case-insensitive; --text case-insensitive literal matched over topic and body; --limit max results, default 20, 0 for all; --since on or after; --until on or before; --json JSON output.
  logs: --thread as above; --text case-insensitive literal over entry lines; --limit default 20, 0 for all; --since; --until; --json.
  activity: --thread limit to one thread; --since; --until; --json.
  overview: --limit recent items to list, default 5; --since; --until; --json.

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--type", "Meeting", "--limit", "10"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--since", "2026-01-01", "--json"]
  ["overview", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["activity", "--since", "2026-08-01"]

Notes:
  Paths are emitted absolute, resolved against the vault root; hand them straight to a file reader without joining them to the working directory.
  Dates filter on the event date from frontmatter timestamp, not the capture date in the filename; the filename is used only when frontmatter is missing or malformed.
  Exit 1 when a --thread or THREAD value cannot be resolved.
